rules.description: The exact target artifact and source identity are cryptographically bound.
Runner, adapters, harness, prompts, models, runtime, and egress policy are pinned.
Every required adapter is exact-identity bound, STABLE, executed on an approved node, quality-qualified, and carried by verified signed runner evidence.
All referenced evidence exists, is redacted, hash-valid, chain-valid, and Merkle-verifiable.
Authorization and storage checks prove the run cannot cross tenant boundaries.
Runner and control-plane communication is authenticated, scoped, replay-resistant, and bounded.
Wall-clock, stage, token, disk, PID, memory, CPU, and concurrency budgets fail closed.
Only owned resources were removed and cleanup completed without unresolved critical residue.
All policy-required critical journeys ran against the real target and passed.
Workers cannot access private signing material and the issuing key is trusted and current.
Deployment authorization checks the exact certified digest, policy, environment, and lifecycle.
